definitions.explanation: Physical or mental energy put into work, or the strength and stamina of the body. Mostly used in set phrases.
A spirit believed to dwell in a natural thing such as a tree, a flower, or water, as in folk tales and fairy stories.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}バテ→夏バテ：15545_natsubate⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、うなぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{精|せい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけた。
examples.english: To keep from wilting in the summer heat, I ate eel to build up my strength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{起|お}きて→起きる：00521_okiru⟧、{畑仕事|はたけしごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{精|せい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}している→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: He gets up early every morning and puts his energy into working the fields.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精|せい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れた→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧。

⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{絵本|えほん}→絵本：10429_ehon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精|せい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A water spirit living in a lake appears in that picture book.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精|せい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to work with energy; {精|せい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ます→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ is a friendly greeting to someone hard at work
- {精|せい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to work hard at, to put one's energy into
- {精|せい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける: to build up one's stamina, usually by eating something nourishing
- {精|せい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく: to gain stamina ({精|せい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧, food that builds you up)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精|せい}: the spirit of ~ (⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精|せい}, ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精|せい})

WATCH OUT:
- Do not confuse it with せい (fault, cause: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧), usually written in kana. For a fairy in general, the ordinary word is {妖精|ようせい}; {精|せい} needs the thing it lives in: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精|せい}.
